book.name: Yoan
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Yoan byex o

content: Pavulek wei moux matekeing ti yo
Ka moxo di la, eno moxo yei moux ti matek gyeik umbek o.
Moxo xe xel betiyeing teling e, “Putoung, eti wong sewokeing, moux tine venaxow o ma luw ta, om ingwei matek gyeik umbek o?”
Yesu neil embei, “Moux tine se wong sewokeing o ma luw ta se wo sewokeing, qe lul tine qandi bei Anutu xe xuk e gyeip yaing eivek e xe mapieing.
Kawei bendiyeing ne eno xey a bong xuk wou tambiy tiwei wong a lam o. De boukeing nam eno xelti tyek se bong xuk.
Gyeik ingwei a toundei eivek tembuing sapa ne, eno a maxow xeiyaing wei tembuing sapa yo.”
Yesu neil ambei nyon, dom pesuv myalouk lek tembuing me wong e wo bandis de toung lek moux tiyon manghalus.
Moxo neil wou e, “La, wang na zipek eivek lounyeing wei Siloam nei” (qayeeng tiyon qes ambei inye wong e la). Om moux tiyon la lipek, de loum beeng eno manghalus yeila.
Moxo xe xel wei e beeng qes o me xel wei yei e takwei gyeik e mindei me tay lulul eno teling bei, “Beip inyei tambiy tiwei mindei me tay lulul o?”
Xel valu neil embei e inyon. De xel valu neil embei, “Ma, inye xel nge ekom ma nambei e.” Ekom moxo venaxow neil xow teyei bei, “Inye ay yo.”
Xel teling e, “Woyom nambei nya wa mamghalus yeila?”
Moxo neil elox bei, “Tambiy tiwei xel mi neil Yesu eno wong tembuing wo bandis me toung lek a mang. Moxo neil wou ay bei a na zipek anghei Siloam. Om a la lipek, de woyom a mang yeila.”
Xel teling e bei, “Moux tiyon inya?” Moxo neil embei, “A se woulek.”
Xel Parisi teling moux tiwei ma yeila yo
Xel qou moux tiwei matekeing eno me la wou xel Parisi.
Bouk tiwei Yesu wong tembuing wo bandis me vindek moux tiyon malek eno inyon Sabat.
Om nambei nyon xel Parisi teling wou e no bei, “Nambei nya wa mam yeila?” Om moxo neil elox, “Moxo toung bandis lek a mang, me a lipek de gweimbeeng a mang yeila.”

Xel Parisi valu neil embei, “Tambiy tine se lam wou Anutu, en se betiwou petieing wei Sabat o.” Ekom xel valu teling, “Nambei nya xel wei sewokeing o tyek bong dee wei lulvako yo nambei nye?” Om xel dembuma.
Se denlek en xel pekwi mend wou moux matekeing on no, “Wambei neil ambei nya en e en ingwei wong wa mam yeila yo?” Moux tiyon neil elox bei, “Moxo poropet ti.”
Yudayeiw se ghei wongis bei moxo matek me mavindek lek, deka xel wo qayeeng la wou moux on ma luw ta wole.
Luw lam de xel teling wou luw, “Inye muw neumim? Inye tambiy tine muw ghe neimbei e matek gyeik umbek o? Nambei nya gweimbeeng e manghalus yeila?”
Ma luw ta lewexe bei, “Uw a woulek bei inye uw neumi, me uw a woulek bei umbek matekeing.
Ekom e yeila gweimbeeng ne nambei nya, o eti wong e ma yeila eno uw se woulek. Xam teling wou e. Moxo wo teiv om tyek na neil xow teyei.”
Moxo ma luw ta neil ambei nyon en luw yaleeng en Yudayeiw, en xel Yudayeiw tup qayeeng bei xelti embei neimbei Yesu e Kilisi, on tyek xel a tiy e veil xomek qekueing ama.
Inyon qes tiyon om ma luw ta neil embei, “Moxo wo teiv, om xam teling wou e.”
Om luyuw eno xel taxe moux tiwei matekeing o me neil wou, “Wa sanghoxe Anutu, en xa woulek bei tambiy tiyon mi wong sewokeing.”
Moxo neil elox bei, “Beip e mi wo sewokeing o ma, a se woulek. A woulek lulti bei a mang tek ekom gweimbeeng a mang yeila!”
Woyom xel teling wou e, “Moxo wong ambei nya wou wang? E wong wa mam yeila nambei nya?”
Moxo lewexe bei, “A neil wou xam woy ekom xam seng ngo. Nambei nya xam ambei ngo no? Xam a being bong ambei e xe betiyeing is?”
Woyom xel wo vyend wou e me neil embei, “Wang on tambiy tiyon xe betiyeing! De xa ne betiyeing wei Mose yo!
Xa woulek bei Anutu luk is Mose, ekom en tambiy tiyon, eno xa se woulek bei e lam anghei inya.”
De moux on lewexe bei, “Gweimbeeng xam ghe neil qayeeng on nelu ti! Xam seng woulek ingwei e lam anghei yo, qe moxo wong a mang yeila.
Xey a woulek bei Anutu se mi ngo xel wei sewokeing o. Qe moxo mi ngo xel wei mi wo lalo wou e me betiwou e yo.
Xelti se mi ngo ka bei, xelti wong tambiy wei umbek matekeing eno ma yeila.
Wangwei Anutu se bong tambiy tiyon nam, on tyek se bong lulti.”
Xel neil elox bei, “Sewokeing pup wang gyeik wang umbek o, wambei teyoxe xa!” De xel tiy moxo la.
Xel wei se wongis eno mend tek
Yesu ngo bei xel tiy e, de gyeik ingwei moxo yei e, eno neil wou bei, “Wang wongis Xomaxoneing Neu Moux?”
Moux on teling bei, “Teiv, tambiy tiyon eti? Wa neil wou ay en a bongis e yo.”
Yesu neil embei, “Gweimbeeng wang wei e, inye tambiy tiwei di luk is wang ne.”
Woyom moux on neil embei, “Tambiy Ngandoung, a wongis o,” de moxo wo lalo wou Yesu.
Yesu neil embei, “A lam eivek tembuing tine en qayeeng wongeing, en kandek xel wei mend tekeing eno gyeina de eti yeiw wei mend yeila eno tyek bo mend tekeing.”
Xel Parisi valu wei toundei is e eno ngo ingwei e neil ambei nyon om xel teling, “Vati? Wambei xa mami tek is?”
Yesu neil embei, “Wangwei xam mamim atek, on sewokeing ma veil xam, ekom xam ghe mi neimbei xam mamim yeila, om sewokeing nanghei di yeip wou xam.”
